item.name: Get information about available services, chains and tokens

request.name: Get information about available services, chains and tokens

description.content:
Get a set of current possibilities based on a request that specifies which chains, exchanges and bridges are preferred or unwanted.
**Attention**: This request is more complex and intended to be used via our [JavaScript SDK](https://docs.li.fi/integrate-li.fi-js-sdk/install-li.fi-sdk).

header.description: Authentication header, register in the LI.FI Partner Portal (https://portal.li.fi/ ) to get your API Key.

response.name: Object listing current possibilities for any-to-any cross-chain-swaps based on the provided preferences.

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

header.description: Authentication header, register in the LI.FI Partner Portal (https://portal.li.fi/ ) to get your API Key.

item.name: Get a set of routes for a request that describes a transfer of tokens

request.name: Get a set of routes for a request that describes a transfer of tokens

description.content:
In order to execute any transfer, you must first request possible `Routes`. From the result set a `Route` can be selected and executed by retrieving the transaction for every included `Step` using the `/steps/transaction` endpoint.
**Attention**: This request is more complex and intended to be used via our [JavaScript SDK](https://docs.li.fi/integrate-li.fi-js-sdk/install-li.fi-sdk).

header.description: Authentication header, register in the LI.FI Partner Portal (https://portal.li.fi/ ) to get your API Key.

response.name: The resulting routes that can be used to realize the described transfer of tokens

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

request.name: Populate a step with transaction data

description.content:
This endpoint expects a full `Step` object which usually is retrieved by calling the `/advanced/routes` endpoint and selecting the most suitable `Route`. Afterwards the transaction for every required `Step` can be retrieved using this endpoint.
**Attention**: This request is more complex and intended to be used via our [JavaScript SDK](https://docs.li.fi/integrate-li.fi-js-sdk/install-li.fi-sdk).

query.description: Parameter to skip transaction simulation. The quote will be returned faster but the transaction gas limit won't be accurate.
Mayan specific option to bridge from non-EVM chain to Hyperliquid
Priority fee level for Solana Virtual Machine (SVM) transactions.

header.description: Authentication header, register in the LI.FI Partner Portal (https://portal.li.fi/ ) to get your API Key.
